title: Quran Study from Behrouz 19: Quran 2:89–119, Witchcraft, Reversion, and the Blue Quran

cases.question: Why did people reject the confirming scripture?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad reads the rejection of a confirming scripture and says resentment arose because God selected an unexpected servant. Related verses about ridiculing a human messenger and worshiping ego are introduced. The study continues through Moses, the calf, Sinai raised overhead, and the challenge to those claiming Heaven is reserved exclusively for them.

cases.question: How did Rashad advise someone troubled by recurring guilt?
cases.expected_answer_note: A participant asks how to resist recurring guilt and temptation. Rashad says repentance erases sins and turns them into credits, while Satan uses guilt and reverse psychology. Five prayers, Ramadan fasting, Quran reading, and constant remembrance strengthen resistance. Sura 110 and Quran 5:54 are used to predict mass acceptance and praise believers who do not fear blame.

cases.question: What role did Gabriel have?
cases.expected_answer_note: Quran 2:97–101 is read. Gabriel revealed the Quran into Muhammad's heart in accordance with God's will. Rejecting God, angels, messengers, Gabriel, or Michael is condemned. Followers of scripture are criticized for disregarding their own scripture when a confirming messenger arrives, which Rashad applies to contemporary religious publications.

cases.question: How did Rashad define witchcraft?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad defines witchcraft and magic as using jinn. He describes contacting jinn, television psychics and ESP performers, prediction tricks, the temporary cooperation of jinn, Solomon's powers, and the angels Harut and Marut bringing knowledge as a test. The knowledge can be abused to separate spouses but cannot harm anyone outside God's will.

cases.question: What personal witchcraft story did Rashad tell?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad recounts a woman allegedly using witchcraft against him from Haiti, after which the jinn supposedly returned the harm and nearly killed or paralyzed her. He affirms voodoo and doll-poking as real jinn mechanisms, discusses divorce, evil-eye practices, psychiatric patients, and says angels protect people who declare God as Lord and lead a righteous life.

cases.expected_answer_note: Quran 2:106–119 is read through the mathematical miracle, jealousy that causes believers to revert, pardon, Contact Prayer, zakat, and the post-retirement account. Those devoted absolutely to God alone can be saved regardless of label. Jewish and Christian mutual rejection, mosque attendance, divine omnipresence, rejection of divine sonship, creation by command, and miracles for the certain follow.

cases.question: Why did Rashad call the book obsolete before publication?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad describes the newly printed blue Quran as partly obsolete before publication because the terminology and movement had developed. He says Muslim Perspective became Submitter's Perspective and Islam became submission in the final translation. He recounts the printing schedule changing from Friday August 18 to Saturday August 19, license-plate signs in Washington, and the exact finishing time. The recording closes with Quran 6:9–10 on an angel appearing as a man and ridicule of messengers.
